userStories.title: Create useTheme hook with localStorage + matchMedia
userStories.description: As a studio user, I want the app to remember my theme choice and respond to OS-level changes.
acceptanceCriteria: New file apps/web/src/hooks/use-theme.ts
On mount reads localStorage['seeflow:theme'] (default 'system')
Resolves 'system' to 'light' | 'dark' via window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
Subscribes to matchMedia changes so OS-level theme flips propagate while app is open
Imperatively toggles document.documentElement.classList between 'light' and 'dark'
Writes changes back to localStorage
Returns { theme, setTheme, resolvedTheme }
New apps/web/src/hooks/use-theme.test.ts covers: localStorage roundtrip, 'system' → matchMedia resolution, OS-preference change subscription, <html> class application
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
